info.name: Hotel Offer Orchestrator
info.description:
API tests for the Hotel Offer Orchestrator (Node.js + TypeScript, Express, Temporal, Redis).

Run the folders in order (Collection Runner or `npm run test:postman`). Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:3000).

Diagnostic response headers: X-Cache (HIT/MISS), X-Workflow-Id, X-Price-Filter, X-Partial-Result, X-Supplier-Status, X-Request-Id.

item.description: Optional scenario from the assignment. The mock suppliers have a fault-injection API: PUT /admin/suppliers/{A|B} with {"mode": "up"|"down"|"slow"|"invalid", "delayMs": n, "failNextRequests": n}. Changing it clears cached snapshots so the next request runs the workflow again.
